What to Look For After a Storm

  • Slates or tiles in the garden, on the drive or in the gutter
  • Gaps in the roof where slates or tiles used to be
  • Ridge tiles that have moved or lifted
  • A chimney pot or flashing that has shifted
  • Water coming through a ceiling during or after the storm

Useful to Tell Us About Storm Damage

  • Whether water is getting in now
  • What you can see from the ground: missing slates, a moved ridge, a fallen chimney pot
  • When the storm was, and whether anything has been covered over since
